paragraphs.text: Zhalfir is the upcoming 120th Magic expansion, to be released October 1, 2027. It is set on the Afrofantasy-inspired plane of Zhalfir . Zhalfir originally was a region on Dominaria . Due to Zhalfir taking New Phyrexia's location in the Multiverse , it is now a full plane orbited by five suns .
Due to the five suns orbiting Zhalfir, nightfall never occurs. Zhalfir has a spirit realm which is permanently dark, and occupied by the dead and other spirits.
